title: fix(web): no nested table scroll or tab-strip scrollbar on any page

summaries.body:
<!-- maple-pr-review c945b13d-cff8-460b-871a-7bbf155e103f 0 -->
## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
Two Tailwind class tweaks with no logic, no caller contract change and no test asserting the old classes.
<sub>no findings · tests not needed · risk low</sub>

Two Tailwind tweaks: the shared underline tab strip stops scrolling vertically, and the Google Cloud services, Pub/Sub and Cloud SQL tables drop their 640px cap so the page scrolls instead. Contained and safe to merge.

- `underlineTabStrip` adds `overflow-y-hidden`, killing the tab strip's stray up/down arrows
- `servicesTable`, `subscriptionsTable` and `databasesTable` no longer pass `maxHeight`

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- Underline still shows the same 1px: `overflow-y:visible` beside `overflow-x:auto` already computed to `auto` and clipped at the padding box (`underline-tabs.ts:27`)
- The other Google Cloud tables were already uncapped (`list/view-resources.ts:45`, `workload/view-sql.ts:167`), so the page's scroll area carries the rows
- Nothing sticky lived inside the capped table area — the sticky head in `infra/kit/data-table.ts:97` only applied when `maxHeight` was set, and no GCP view uses `sticky`

</details>

## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge Pure Tailwind class changes with no logic; the only defect is a comment left contradicting the scroll it describes, and no test pins the layout. 1 note · tests not needed · risk medium Removes the nested scroll areas that produced two scrollbars: the shared tab strips stop scrolling vertically, and the GCP, Cloudflare, PlanetScale and agent-session tables no longer cap their height. Contained CSS-only change, safe to merge. - `underlineTabStrip` and the span-panel tab list add `overflow-y-hidden` - `dataTable` callers on the GCP, Cloudflare and PlanetScale pages drop `maxHeight` - `toolTableBody` no longer sets `overflow-y-auto` or a 460px cap ### Findings
🔵 Note · F1 · Comment still says the row area scrolls after the cap was removed maintainability · [`apps/web/src/page/infra-integrations/cloudflare/list/view-tables.ts:44`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/917f1303fa039fe98848e77fd7594c96c9dc9e44/apps/web/src/page/infra-integrations/cloudflare/list/view-tables.ts#L44) The same hunk deletes `TABLE_MAX_HEIGHT`, so `zoneTable` and `workerTable` now grow the page, but the comment above still explains why "the row area scrolls rather than growing the page". It now reads as the reason to keep a cap that is gone. ``` // The server caps the list at 500 rows; the table shows them all and the page scrolls. ```
What was checked - Callers that still need a cap keep it: the analytics cards and dialogs still pass `maxHeight` and `stickySurfaceClass` (`page/infra/kit/data-table.ts:94`) - Both `toolTableBody` call sites updated, no caller passes the removed `maxHeight` (`tools/view-table.ts:263`, `tool/view-errors.ts:484`) - `dataTable` still emits `overflow-x-auto`, so wide tables keep their sideways scroll
